work.author: GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS
work.description: Bull CXI (GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS servus servorum Dei LF21014–21015) separates S. Maria di Sitria from S. Gaudenzio in Barbara, unites it to Fonte Avellana and suppresses SS. Bartolomeo ed Emiliano; page transitions across own provenance LF21078 and running title LF21081, page numbers LF21153/21225, running titles LF21325/21394, signature LF21466 and page number LF21469, sheet number 19 LF21539 and page number 146 LF21542. On artifact page 156 the OCR emits the left column in two blocks with the right column’s head between them: LF21597 deputationis, → LF21650 mandati, derogationis follows in native order (left column, y2471 → y2497); the intervening page-146 running title LF21600 and CXII’s heading, address and first body lines LF21603–21647 are excluded as furniture and as another act’s text; complete closing dated quinto kalendas octobris 1836 LF21657–21660. Lines with literal OCR marks | and the garbled LF21397–21398 (. Crucis … eiteeeniad) remain literal. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS at LF21014–21014; the source closing at LF21657–21660 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Ma- iorem anno incarnatiouis dominicae millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo sexto, quinto kalendas octobris, pontificatus Nostri anno sexto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
